svg.title: Unreal Engine — Animation essentials
svg.desc: Nine core Unreal Engine animation types: shared skeleton and mesh assets, the sequence inheritance chain, and component, instance, proxy and runtime node relationships.

g.text: Left / center: mesh and runtime. Right: animation asset inheritance.
Solid triangle outline = inheritance; filled diamond = owned proxy; plain line = reference.
RefSkeleton = FReferenceSkeleton; dt = float DeltaSeconds; ctx / pose / data abbreviate parameters.
Selected members only; const qualifiers and common UObject / component / asset bases omitted.
Concrete player nodes, graph links, state machines, montages and editor types are not expanded.
